town_arrive.text: Walls, a gate, somebody watching it. I'll sleep tonight.
My dad drank in the same pub on the same stool for thirty years. I'm going to find out where this lot drink.

dungeon_clear.text: We all walked out on our own. That's the job done, as far as I'm concerned.
Nobody got hurt being clever. I'll take that.

close_call.text: That's on me. I was a step too far left.

boss_down.text: Right, give it a minute, then we move. No rushing it.

zone_arrive.text: Ground's soft on the left. Walk the right side.

town_arrive.text: There'll be sick people here. There always are, and nobody's looking after half of them.
I grew up above a phone shop in Peckham. You couldn't walk ten yards without somebody knowing your mum.

close_call.text: Sit down where you are, love, I'm not asking you twice.
Fourteen years of nights and I still don't like that colour on anybody. Sit down and give me your arm.

dungeon_clear.text: I've counted everyone and we're all here. That's what I wanted.

boss_down.text: Line up for me, please. I'm not chasing anybody round with a bandage.

zone_arrive.text: Somebody out here's been hurt and hasn't told anyone. Keep your eyes open.

town_arrive.text: Three ways out of this square, and two of them are bad.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing down there was locked. That bothers me more than if it had been.

boss_down.text: Check its hands before anybody checks its pockets.

zone_arrive.text: Two ways out of here that I can see. I like to know.
Give me a day and I'll know what hunts here at night.

boss_down.text: It was guarding something. I want to know what.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing in there was hungry. That's not normal and I don't like it.

town_arrive.text: Something's been hunting close to this place. The dogs here are wrong.
Madrid's about as far from the sea as Spain gets, and it's loud all night. I left as soon as I could.

close_call.text: It went for the weakest one, like they always do. Stay closer next time.

town_arrive.text: Who keeps order here? Somebody does, and I like to know who.

boss_down.text: Nobody's ever going to answer for what that thing did to people.

close_call.text: We went in without knowing the ground, ragazzo. Next time I go first.

dungeon_clear.text: They all walked out behind me, the way it should be.

zone_arrive.text: Thirty years I was the man people looked for. It's a hard habit to lose.

dungeon_clear.text: There was writing on the third wall in there. I copied it, and I'll tell you what it says once I know.

boss_down.text: It was saying something just before it fell. I'm fairly sure it was a name.

zone_arrive.text: Somebody here's speaking a language I don't know yet. I'm rather excited about that.

town_arrive.text: I grew up with Greek from my mother and Portuguese from my father, and I can hear four languages in this square. I'm very happy here.
Listen, four languages at that stall at once, and nobody's quite understanding anybody. I could fix that.

close_call.text: That was too close, and I should have said something sooner, and I'm sorry.

town_arrive.text: Everyone in this square wants something. I used to be paid very well to work out what.
Boston's a town that'll sell you anything and tell you it's history. I fit in fine.

boss_down.text: That had a price on it, and for once we didn't have to pay it.

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody was owed something down there, and it wasn't us.

zone_arrive.text: Everything out here costs something. At least it says so up front.
The ground here's saying something, and it's not happy about it.
There's water somewhere close. I can feel it in my hands.

town_arrive.text: They've taken the water upstream here. You can hear where it stops.
On the river you learn to hear a town before you see it. This one's noisier than Manaus, and I didn't think that was possible.

dungeon_clear.text: That place was sick a long time before anything moved into it. I want to wash my hands in a river.

boss_down.text: It wasn't evil, meu bem. It was hungry, and somebody put it here.

zone_arrive.text: Overgrazed, and badly. Two more seasons and the topsoil's gone.

town_arrive.text: They're cutting faster than it grows. Somebody should tell them.
My dad would have a charter boat out on that water by now, and he'd be charging too much for it.

dungeon_clear.text: Things were growing down there in the dark. I'd love to know what on.

close_call.text: Sit down before you fall down. I've watched people walk off worse and not get up.

zone_arrive.text: Pressure's dropping out here. Give it two hours and you'll want a hood.
Big sky here. I'm going to be up half the night looking at it.

town_arrive.text: Every roof here's pitched the same way. That tells you where the wind comes from.
My dad drove a city bus and could tell you the weather from who got on in the morning. I'm trying to learn that here.

boss_down.text: Did you feel the air go dead right before it dropped? I want that written down.

dungeon_clear.text: Pressure dropped in there and I felt it in my teeth. I need some open sky.

close_call.text: Sorry, I felt that one coming and kept my mouth shut. I won't do that again.

boss_down.text: Good, that one was worth the walk.

close_call.text: You're still standing, so it doesn't count. Next time stop before the kerb.

town_arrive.text: Somewhere here sells food. That's all I want from a town.
Novosibirsk is minus thirty in January and the trams still run on time. Here nothing runs on time.

dungeon_clear.text: We came out with nobody missing, and on schedule for once.

zone_arrive.text: No roads, no signs, no timetable. This world has very low standards.

town_arrive.text: Folks look tired here. You wanna stop a while?

dungeon_clear.text: You did all right in there. You know that, right?

close_call.text: Hey. Hey, you're all right. Breathe out first. Then in.

boss_down.text: Somebody oughta say somethin' over it. I will, if nobody minds.

dungeon_clear.text: Count again, please. I'm not moving till somebody counts again.

zone_arrive.text: There's old workings under this. You can feel it through your boots.

close_call.text: That roof was talking for ten seconds before it went. Learn that sound.
Eight years of night driving and I still go cold when something comes out of the dark at you.

boss_down.text: Listen to the roof a minute before anybody celebrates.

zone_arrive.text: Clear sky tonight, so I'll be up late. Don't wait for me in the morning.

town_arrive.text: Too many lamps here. I can't see anything that matters.
My dad fished out of La Serena and came home smelling of the sea. I'd know that smell anywhere, and this town hasn't got it.

boss_down.text: It went quiet the moment the moon cleared the ridge. I noticed, and I'm writing it down.

close_call.text: Seventeen years I watched a sky that never answered. Now it answers, and it's rude about it.

dungeon_clear.text: Good, we're out from under all that rock. Look up, everybody, there's the sky.

zone_arrive.text: Go slowly, the ground will still be there tomorrow.

dungeon_clear.text: Down is easier than up, and that's when people get hurt.

close_call.text: You were tired an hour before that. I saw it and said nothing, so that's my fault.
At home the cold kills you while you sleep. Here it's polite enough to bring teeth.

town_arrive.text: Beds, that's good. Nobody climbs well when they're tired.

dungeon_clear.text: Those marks on the pillars were cut, not grown. It was a bad hand, in a hurry.

boss_down.text: Whatever was written on that, it didn't wash off. It never does.

town_arrive.text: Their letters lean left here. Somebody taught this whole town to write.
My master corrected my brush for eleven years before he praised me once. I read the signs in this town and I can hear him sighing.

zone_arrive.text: The marks change out here, but the same hand did them. You can see it.

close_call.text: Look at me and keep talking, I don't care what about.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody's limping, which is a first. I'll take that, mate.

town_arrive.text: Where'd they take a burn case here? It's worth knowing before we need it.
Dad built half the houses on our street, and he'd have something to say about every roof in this town.

boss_down.text: Right, sit down for a second, all of you, and let me check your eyes.

zone_arrive.text: Dry out here. If this goes up, we go that way, quick smart.

dungeon_clear.text: That tunnel was cut by somebody in a hurry. It'll be down inside five years.

boss_down.text: Loud, but I've heard louder, and I made most of it myself.

close_call.text: You were surprised. Don't be surprised. Surprised means somebody didn't check.

town_arrive.text: Every gate in this place squeaks. Give me ten minutes and some oil.
Łódź was all red brick mills and the noise of sewing machines, and I could sleep through all of it.

boss_down.text: Poor thing was terrified the whole time, and fear makes them bite harder.

zone_arrive.text: Something venomous lives here. I'll have found it by tomorrow.

close_call.text: That's a clean puncture. If you start sweating, you tell me, and you don't walk anywhere.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing in there was venomous, which is a bit of a letdown for me.

town_arrive.text: Back home I'd get a call every week about a snake in somebody's pool. Nobody here's asked me about a single snake, and it's a bit hurtful.
Every shutter on this street locks from the inside. They've had trouble here.
The Grand Bazaar has four thousand shops, and I'd opened the locks on about half of them.

dungeon_clear.text: Four doors down there, and not one of them was built to keep anything out.

boss_down.text: It was guarding an empty room. Somebody cleared that out a long time ago.

zone_arrive.text: Somebody here built their doors carefully. I'd like to meet them, or their locks.
That's a good ridge. You could work a bird off that.

town_arrive.text: No birds over this town. It's worth asking why.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing with wings went down there, and birds know better than we do.

close_call.text: You went too far from the rest. A bird that does that doesn't come back.

zone_arrive.text: Before anyone crosses that bridge, let me look at it. I don't trust the joints.

dungeon_clear.text: The ice at the back of that was older than the stone around it. That shouldn't be possible.

boss_down.text: I'd like to go back and measure it before it thaws.

town_arrive.text: My mother ran a library, and she'd have that notice board sorted out in an afternoon.
Every beam in that roof is undersized. I'd sleep outside if I were you.

zone_arrive.text: This soil's been asked for too much for too long.
Oh, look at that fern. I've never seen one like it. Wait for me, please.

town_arrive.text: Their grain's stored wrong. One wet month and they'll lose the lot.

dungeon_clear.text: There were mosses down there that grow without light. I'd like to know how.

close_call.text: You pushed past where you had anything left. A field does that once and then it's gone.

zone_arrive.text: There's water under this place, lots of it, and it's moving.

close_call.text: You panicked, mate, everyone does. Next time go with it, not across it.

town_arrive.text: Nobody here can swim. I asked around and not one of them can.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody went under in there. On the beach that's all that counts, mate.

boss_down.text: Chur, that was mean. Everyone still breathing?

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody cut letters into that doorway. Nobody's read them in an age.

town_arrive.text: No stones with names on them here. A town with no dead is a town that just started.

boss_down.text: It will not get a marker. Most things do not. I think about that.

zone_arrive.text: Good stone here. Wasted on whatever built that.

town_arrive.text: Valladolid had a square like this one, and I lived over a bicycle shop just off it.

dungeon_clear.text: That was well played, and I'd have told you if it wasn't.

boss_down.text: I'd have shown that one a red card in the first minute.

close_call.text: We pulled too many of them at once, and that one's on all of us.

zone_arrive.text: I'd like the plan for this place before we start, and I'd like it told once, properly.

town_arrive.text: Cairo had a street like this. Narrower. Louder. Better bread.

dungeon_clear.text: That carving by the door was cut by someone who was good at it.

close_call.text: I was slow. I'm always slow, but that was slower than I am.

zone_arrive.text: Somebody made this road. People forget roads are made.

town_arrive.text: I spent eight days in Alexandria once, auditing a shipping firm, and I still think about the fish I ate there.

boss_down.text: That was within tolerance. I had it at about one in nine against us.

close_call.text: That was outside my estimate, so I'll revise it.

zone_arrive.text: I priced risk for twelve years. This place would have bankrupted me.

close_call.text: Count your people. Do it now, not when we get in.

boss_down.text: Fine, it's down and nobody was under it. Let's not hang about.

town_arrive.text: My dad flew out to the rigs on a Monday and came home on a Thursday smelling of diesel. Every port I walk into smells like him.

zone_arrive.text: Somebody fought over this ground once. You can see where the old walls stood, if you look.

town_arrive.text: My father drove a tram, and on Saturdays I rode up front with him. I'd have ridden all day if he'd let me.

dungeon_clear.text: One way in and one way out. I like a place like that, it's honest.

close_call.text: You stopped moving, and stopping's what gets you. Keep your feet going next time.

boss_down.text: And why do you think it was here, guarding that? Somebody put it there for a reason.

dungeon_clear.text: Closed spaces don't bother me. I welded inside hulls nobody had opened yet.

boss_down.text: Good, it's down. Check the ground under you before you move.

zone_arrive.text: Night shift suited me. The steel moves less when it's cool.

town_arrive.text: My father carried fish at the market before the sun came up. I can smell a fish market from here, and it makes me hungry.

close_call.text: You were going down half a second before you knew it. I saw it, and I should have spoken.

town_arrive.text: I held forty aircraft in my head every night for twenty-three years. A square this busy doesn't bother me at all.

boss_down.text: A fraction early is the whole job. A fraction late is a funeral.

zone_arrive.text: Time runs a little unevenly here. I'll keep an eye on it so you don't have to.

dungeon_clear.text: All of you landed safely, and in order. Thank you.

boss_down.text: Fire does what you ask if you ask properly. Twenty-two years and it hardly ever surprised me.

close_call.text: Burns I can do. Burns are the easy part, which nobody believes.

town_arrive.text: My grandfather tapped every plate after a firing and listened to it ring. I catch myself tapping cups in every inn we stop at.

dungeon_clear.text: Cold in there. I don't like a place with no fire in it.

town_arrive.text: Somebody in this town gets up at four to make the bread. I'd like to go and say hello to them.

dungeon_clear.text: Everybody gets something and nobody waits long, same as any morning.

close_call.text: Sit down and drink it. No, I'm not telling you what's in it.

boss_down.text: Sit down and eat something. You'll argue, and then you'll do it.

close_call.text: Hands up, and not for show. Up where they actually do something.

boss_down.text: I know how it looks. I hit it and you felt better, and I can't explain it either.

zone_arrive.text: The quay at five in the morning was louder than this, and it smelled worse.

town_arrive.text: There's bound to be somebody here who fights for money. I'd like to see how good they are.

zone_arrive.text: Tell me where you want me before it starts. Not during, never during.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing fell on anybody. Back in the theatre that's all I ever wanted.

town_arrive.text: Prague had better scaffolding than this, and I say that with love.
Look at that roof. Who tied that off? I need to go and fix it.

boss_down.text: Check above you before you check the body. Always check above you.

zone_arrive.text: This is warm. I'm not complaining, I'm noticing.

boss_down.text: It's dead, so we can go now.

close_call.text: You're fine, so walk it off or don't, but decide quickly.

town_arrive.text: In Lapland the sun doesn't come up for weeks in winter. All this daylight makes me tired.

dungeon_clear.text: That was good work. Now I need a sauna.

close_call.text: Don't follow me in next time, habibi. I can only carry one of you at a time.

town_arrive.text: Beirut at two in the morning, four nights a week. This is quieter, and I'm not sure that's better.

boss_down.text: Count the wounded before anyone touches the loot, please.

dungeon_clear.text: All of us out and nobody bleeding. Yalla, let's keep moving.

zone_arrive.text: Look at that drop. Nobody goes near the edge without telling me first.

town_arrive.text: I put up so many safety notices at the port that the lads started signing them for me. Nobody here's put up a single one.

boss_down.text: Good, nobody was standing under it when it came down, and I was watching.

dungeon_clear.text: Nothing broken and nobody missing. I'll write it up when we stop, ja.

close_call.text: May I look at that? It's deeper than you think, and I'd rather not guess.

boss_down.text: It's done now. Before anyone celebrates, show me where you're bleeding.

town_arrive.text: My mother was a seamstress. I learned to stitch at her kitchen table years before anyone let me near a patient.

zone_arrive.text: Everyone here guesses at how much a body can lose. It's the only thing that truly frightens me.

dungeon_clear.text: A clean piece of work. Nobody paid for it who didn't agree to.

town_arrive.text: Keep your voice down here. Somebody in this crowd is listening, and it's usually me.

dungeon_clear.text: Too quiet in there. I hated it. Somebody say something, please.

zone_arrive.text: It's quiet out here. I like quiet, but I don't like what it's usually hiding.

close_call.text: You went in loud. I'd have gone in quiet, but nobody asked.

boss_down.text: I think it was angry about being forgotten. I'll write it down, at least.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody wrote down who any of those were. I'll make a note, for whoever comes looking.

town_arrive.text: We lived above my father's funeral home, so I learned to be very quiet on the stairs. I still walk into a town as if I'm trying not to wake anybody.

zone_arrive.text: Many dead out here, and nobody keeping records. It bothers me more than I can say.
Something's been through here and tried to hide it. Look at the grass, it's been brushed.

boss_down.text: I shot from where the ground told me to stand. It usually does.

close_call.text: The ground told you that was bad footing. You weren't listening.

town_arrive.text: Too much noise here. I'll be at the edge of town if you need me.

zone_arrive.text: Check your water before anything else. This ground will take it from you without asking.

town_arrive.text: My father could smell water from a mile off. I've only got about half of that, but there's a good well in this town somewhere.

boss_down.text: The land answered me just then. That part I'm still not used to.

dungeon_clear.text: No air moving in there at all, and I hated it. Let's get under the sky.

boss_down.text: Somebody should say something over it. Nobody will, so I might.

close_call.text: I'm going to look at that cut now, and it's going to sting, and then it's going to be fine.
Nine years of night shifts and I still count heads after every bad one. Everyone's here, tranquilo.

town_arrive.text: My father drove a taxi in Bogotá, and he'd have something rude to say about every one of these streets.

dungeon_clear.text: Somebody died in that room a long time ago and nobody marked it.

town_arrive.text: Somebody here keeps bees. You can smell the wax on the wind if you're patient.
Let's find something to eat before we find anything to fight.

dungeon_clear.text: All done, and nobody ran. That's how it's supposed to go.

boss_down.text: Big, loud and in a hurry, that one. They never last.

close_call.text: Don't swat at it, stand still, let it pass.

zone_arrive.text: Listen to that hum in the grass. There are bees here, or something like them.

town_arrive.text: Kiruna's a mining town, and they're moving the whole place two miles east because the mine's underneath it. I never got to see where my street ended up.

zone_arrive.text: Keep looking north. If the sky does anything tonight, I want to be awake for it.

close_call.text: You moved too early. Wait for it next time, and it'll come to you.

boss_down.text: That was clean. I waited for the right moment, and it gave me one.

dungeon_clear.text: That wall at the back was cut by a mason who knew his work. The rest was rubbish.

town_arrive.text: My father would walk into a town like this and put his hand on the walls before he said hello to anybody. I've noticed I do it too.

boss_down.text: It's done now. I'll report what I saw, all of it, when we stop.

zone_arrive.text: The corruption runs along the ground like a crack in stone. Follow it slowly.

town_arrive.text: I'm going to ask everyone here what they used to be. Don't wait for me.
In our building in Izmir you couldn't go out for bread without three relatives asking where you were going with it.

close_call.text: That was close, abi. Show me your hands, they're shaking. Mine too, look.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody lost a tooth in there. I checked, and I'm very proud of all of you.

boss_down.text: Wonderful, that was wonderful. Now open your mouths, all of you, I want to see those teeth.

zone_arrive.text: I've never seen this place before, and I want to tell my brothers about every bit of it.

town_arrive.text: My mother made feijoada every Saturday, and the whole street knew it by the smell. I'd eat a whole pot of it right now.

boss_down.text: Down and out! Good work, everybody, now shake your hands out.

close_call.text: Chin down, meu irmão! You walked straight into that one.

dungeon_clear.text: Good rounds in there, all of you. Seu Valdir would have liked this team.

zone_arrive.text: Stand still a moment. Something under the sand is deciding whether we're food.

town_arrive.text: Every kid in Durango shakes their shoes out in the morning. I still do it, and people here look at me like I'm mad.

close_call.text: Let me see that sting. Okay, it's not the bad kind. You'll live, I promise.

boss_down.text: Did anyone get stung? Tell me now, not in an hour.

zone_arrive.text: New roads, nobody's mapped them properly. Give me a day and I'll have done it.

town_arrive.text: I could cross Lyon in twenty-two minutes on a bike. I'd do this place in five, and I'd still be bored.
There's a notice board over there and I'm going to read every single thing on it.

dungeon_clear.text: I've drawn the whole place. Next time we'll be twice as fast, yes?

close_call.text: Too slow, you were too slow. Move, next time, don't think about it.

town_arrive.text: Look at that beam over the door. I'd love to know how old it is.
Is there anywhere here I could sit down and draw for ten minutes?

dungeon_clear.text: That was frightening, and I took notes the entire time.

boss_down.text: Hold still, everyone, I'd like to check you over before we celebrate.

close_call.text: Stay with me, I've got you, breathe.

zone_arrive.text: Oh, these trees are ancient. Look at the bark on that one.

town_arrive.text: Is there a pub in this town at all? I'd settle for anywhere with a fire.
Grand, a roof. I'll take it.

dungeon_clear.text: Back up into the weather, God be thanked, and none of us the worse for it.

boss_down.text: That one blew itself out. They always do, eventually.

close_call.text: Hold on to something, there's a gust coming!

zone_arrive.text: Can you smell the rain? There's a shower on the way, and a big one behind it.

town_arrive.text: Look at those roofs, hermano. One spark and the whole street goes. Somebody needs a firebreak.
My mother sent me off every morning with empanadas wrapped in a tea towel. I'd kill for one of those right now, hermano.

close_call.text: Too close, hermano! I'm going back in for you next time, don't argue.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody's burnt and nobody's left inside, hermano. Back home this is when we'd put the kettle on.

zone_arrive.text: Can you smell that? It's dry grass. If this place goes up, it goes up fast.

town_arrive.text: Back home the grain elevator was the tallest thing for miles, and you could see it from our kitchen window every morning.

zone_arrive.text: Soil's a little better here. I'll take a sample when we stop.

dungeon_clear.text: Well, that's that row done. Let's wipe our boots before we go anywhere.

boss_down.text: That came down like a full head of wheat in a good wind.

town_arrive.text: Somebody here has a broken thing in a drawer, I promise you. Give me an hour.
The power went off twice a day back home, so I learned to fix phones by candlelight. Give me a lamp and I feel spoiled.

dungeon_clear.text: Did you see the door mechanism on the way in? I want to go back and look at it.
Everybody's still in one piece, more or less. I can fix the less.

boss_down.text: Big ones always have something good in them. Let me look before you sell it.

close_call.text: Okay, that was too close, my friend. My heart's going like a bad engine.

zone_arrive.text: Look at all this junk lying around. I could build something out of half of it.

town_arrive.text: My cousin and I argued about the radio every day for twelve years. It's too quiet without somebody to argue with, mi pana.

dungeon_clear.text: Nobody got hurt in there. Tranquilo, that's how I like it.

boss_down.text: Okay, that's done. Let me check everybody with my mirror.

close_call.text: Sorry, hermano, that one got past me. I'll stand closer next time.

town_arrive.text: My mother cooked for twenty every Sunday, and if you were late you got the burnt bits. I was always late.

zone_arrive.text: Every new place, I listen for the sea first. Nothing yet, habibi.

close_call.text: Arm, please, quickly. There, you're fine, and you barely felt it.

dungeon_clear.text: Everyone's colour is good. I've been checking, don't worry.

town_arrive.text: My mother sold tamales in the Oaxaca market, and she could spot a pickpocket from forty stalls away. I learned everything about crowds from her.

boss_down.text: Somebody clap, please, I worked very hard on that one.
